parsed.rationale: Two identical `MockDiscogsEntityResolver` type-alias-objects (both with `shared_field_count: 4` and no differing slots) exist in separate packages: one in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and one in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). Because the mock is already defined in the `Metadata` package — which is the natural home for anything related to Discogs entity resolution — the `app:iOS` copy should be removed and the test in `DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` should import and reuse the one from `Metadata`. This eliminates the exact duplication while keeping the canonical definition close to the domain it mocks.
